plainText:
Shipwreck and "Oh, What Sharp Teeth You Have, Bruxish!" (Japanese: 難破！！歯ぎしりハギギシリ！ Wreck!! Teeth-Grinding !) is the 15th chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.

==Plot==
 
 
==Major events==
Professor Kukui takes and to Ula'ula Island on his yacht.
Using Mantine Surf, Professor Burnet and Lillie meet up with Kukui's group.
A wild attacks everyone, causing the group to get knocked out.
Sun defeats Bruxish with and rescues Lillie, but the two end up separated from the others and end up on an Ula'ula beach.
Acerola finds Sun and Lillie and takes them to the Aether House to recuperate.
After Sun and Lillie properly introduce themselves to each other, Sun realizes that Acerola is a captain.
Moon, Kukui, and Burnet end up rescued by the Aether Foundation and are taken to Aether Paradise to rest up.
Moon's group is greeted by Faba and Wicke, who offer to give them a tour of Aether Paradise.
